data.title: Indian captain 'scapegoat' in Britain's Russia shadow fleet case, wife says
data.description: RAMNAGAR (INDIA) - The Indian captain of an alleged Russian shadow fleet oil vessel seized by British commandos has been made a "scapegoat", his wife told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ), as her husband awaits trial.

data.title: ONE Championship: Takeru hopes future fighters emerge from Myanmar school he helped fund
data.description: Retired Japanese kickboxing great Takeru Segawa hopes future fighters and athletes emerge from a school in Myanmar after finally visiting a new building he helped fund there.

data.title: House asked to look into AoT deals
data.description: <p>Former MP Charnchai Isarasenarak and former senator Adm Phajun Tamprateep have asked the House panel tasked with budget scrutiny to investigate an Airports of Thailand Plc (AoT) board resolution to amend airport duty-free and commercial concession contracts due to projected financial losses.</p>

data.title: Moei River overflows, prompting border market vendors in Mae Sot to move goods
data.description: Continuous heavy rain caused the Moei River in Mae Sot district of Tak province to overflow on Friday morning, forcing vendors at Rim Moei market to move their goods to higher ground.

data.title: Ngern Tidlor Wins Best Financial Inclusion Initiative in Thailand at Asian Banker 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , represented by Mr.Thitided Srimarayat, Senior Vice President of Marketing and Loan Business Development, led Ngern Tidlor to achieve the Best Financial Inclusion Initiative in Thailand under the Retail Finance Product Awards category at The Asian Banker Thailand Awards 2026.

data.title: Indonesia eyes uninhabited island for 1st nuclear power plant
data.description: JAKARTA — Coal-dependent Indonesia is reviving decades-old plans to build nuclear power plants that were put on hold following the 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster in Japan, as it seeks to meet its decarbonisation targets.

data.title: People's Party aiming for Nonthaburi PAO presidency
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has launched its campaign for the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) presidency, with candidate Decharut Sukkumnoed drawing ballot number 4 and urging residents to back him in the Sept 20 election.</p>

data.title: US Treasury buybacks may redirect capital towards Asia
data.description: Larger US Treasury bond buybacks briefly lowered long-term yields and the dollar, raising prospects of capital flows towards Asia and emerging markets

data.title: Maradona trial on hold over possible medical evidence mix-up
data.description: SAN ISIDRO (ARGENTINA) - The latest trial over the death of Argentine football legend Diego Maradona was suspended Thursday following claims that kidney test results presented to the court came from his father.

data.title: 'Greatest' Springboks face All Blacks in clash of juggernauts
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Springbok legend Victor Matfield believes the current South Africa team is the "greatest we have ever had".

data.title: William and Harry: Britain's warring royal brothers
data.description: LONDON - William and Harry were united in grief as children by the tragic death of their mother, Princess Diana, but their relationship as adults has been ripped apart by anger and hurt.

data.title: University suspends academic behind Jason Arday plagiarism charges
data.description: BRUSSELS — A Belgian university on Thursday suspended a US academic who spearheaded accusations of plagiarism against Jason Arday, the black ex-Cambridge professor found dead last week after resigning over the scandal.

data.title: 'I heard you missed me': Melania Trump jokes about month out of spotlight
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US First Lady Melania Trump poked fun Thursday at media speculation over her month away from the public eye and scrutiny over one of President Donald Trump's close aides.

data.title: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists to receive national security verdict
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court will deliver a verdict in the national security trial of two pro-democracy Tiananmen activists on Friday, in a case widely criticised as exemplifying the erosion of freedom of expression in the Chinese city.

data.title: UN holds second informal poll for next leader
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The UN's most powerful body, the Security Council, meets on Friday to hold another straw poll to gauge the popularity of a growing field of contenders to lead the embattled organisation.
